name: calculate_inventory_pricing
title: InventoryPricingCalculator
description: Calculates expected item subtotal, 8% sales tax, and grand total for dynamic e-commerce checkout flows. Supports product filtering by name, price bounds, sorting, price overrides (surge pricing simulation), and out-of-stock item handling.

productNames.description: List of product names selected for purchase in the cart.

sortBy.description: Sorting criteria for the returned catalog items.

taxRate.description: Sales tax rate applied to subtotal (default is 0.08 / 8%).

priceOverrides.description: Dynamic price overrides to simulate surge pricing updates (e.g. {'Sauce Labs Backpack': 39.99}).

excludeOutOfStock.description: Whether items marked as out-of-stock should be omitted from price calculation.

outOfStockProducts.description: List of product names designated as out of stock.

customCatalog.description: Optional custom catalog to evaluate instead of standard Sauce Labs catalog.
